description: Get the horoscope for one zodiac sign or for all twelve, for today, the current week, the current month or the year. Returns the reading plus numeric aspect scores, lucky factors and current transits.

language.description: Set to "hi" to add Hindi (Devanagari) names next to the English ones, for answering in Hindi.

sign.description: One of aries, taurus, gemini, cancer, leo, virgo, libra, scorpio, sagittarius, capricorn, aquarius, pisces. Omit to get all twelve.

name: get_horoscope
title: Zodiac horoscope
